policy.verified_negative_requires: At least one explicit two-tenant or cross-tenant negative test that exercises the resource authorization boundary and fails closed without resource enumeration.
policy.partial_means: Security-relevant authorization or tenant-isolation evidence exists, but a complete explicit two-tenant negative case for the route/resource family has not yet been identified in the current-track corpus.
policy.missing_means: No adequate family-level two-tenant negative evidence has been identified yet.

evidence.proves: A session belonging to ORG_A cannot select ORG_B and fails with TENANT_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
API token scope escalation is rejected and the token principal remains bound to its organization.
ORG_A cannot bind an ORG_B workspace or brand during Project creation.
Cross-tenant Project lookup fails as TENANT_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND and repository lookup returns no resource.
ORG_B cannot read or obtain a signed download for an ORG_A Asset; both fail as TENANT_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
Organization OWNER/ADMIN roles do not exist in the PlatformAdminRole set and the factory requires a platform-admin principal.
Queue/provider/billing/security privileges remain separated across platform-admin roles.
Identical content hashes in two organizations retain different organization IDs and storage buckets.

families.missing: Explicit cross-tenant get/version/fork/restore/download denial using an ORG_A principal against an ORG_B ArtifactVersion.
Explicit two-tenant read/control/resume/cancel negative cases for Task and AgentRun.

evidence.proves: Canonical document/version identity is preserved in projection.

families.missing: Explicit two-tenant Canvas projection and command-batch denial against another organization's exact document/version.
Explicit two-tenant Brand/RuleSet/Proposal read and mutation negative cases.

evidence.proves: Approval public projections minimize internal effect data.

families.missing: Explicit ORG_A actor vs ORG_B Approval request/decision/effect negative cases.

evidence.proves: Collaboration access requires explicit project access rather than organization membership alone.
Mention target must have project access and notification payload minimizes comment content.

families.missing: Explicit two-organization thread/comment read/edit/delete denial using foreign IDs.

evidence.proves: Public Export job/output contracts omit storage bucket/key internals.

families.missing: Explicit two-tenant capability/create/job/cancel/download negative cases for a foreign ArtifactVersion/ExportJob.
Explicit two-tenant Cost summary/usage negative response proving ORG_A cannot query ORG_B cost facts.

evidence.proves: Billing read fails closed without billing.read permission.
Billing webhook and authenticated user Billing routes retain separate trust boundaries.

families.missing: Explicit two-tenant subscription/wallet/invoice/portal negative cases using foreign organization data.

evidence.proves: Organization ADMIN audit-read permission does not imply governance manage or audit export.
Legal Hold blocks destructive deletion workflow.

families.missing: Explicit two-tenant Audit search/Hold/Deletion/Export denial with foreign organization resource IDs.
